<color=black>※</color>Smashes once every 1s and does not disappear after smashing; when not targeting, jumps back to its original tile。
<color=black>※</color>Vulnerable to zombie attack for 0.6s after each smash。
<color=black>※</color>圧殺無効。When crushed, takes 500 damage every 0.02s. When smashed, takes damage equal to the corresponding damage a 催眠されたゾンビ would take when smashed.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>スクワッシュ→パフキノコ</color>

plants.name: 破壊パンプキン
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>破壊パンプキン is always advertising his services as being great for healthier-looking skin, but plant inspectors often complain that his treatments are dangerously radioactive.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Channels the power of 破壊キノコ into the plants inside。

<color=black>耐久力：</color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>※</color>Gains 1% charge every 0.5s; enters the field with a starting charge between 80%-95% randomly。
<color=black>※</color>When charge meter is full(100%), can consume all charge to transform one plant on his tile into a fusion of that plant and 破壊キノコ(the resulting plant must not be an 旅行融合).</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>破壊キノコ→パンプキン</color>

plants.name: スパイク鉢
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Every plant that's spent time with スパイク鉢 complains that he's far too enthusiastic and has no sense of personal boundaries. Only 黒曜石のスパイクナッツ doesn't mind, and the reason is simple: スパイク鉢 is the only one willing to help de-rust 黒曜石のスパイクナッツ's razor-sharp shell.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Has スパイクウィード traits and enhances the defenses of スパイクナッツ plants。

<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>20/1秒</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>※</color>低身植物。スパイクウィードの特性を継承する(ignored by biting zombies and pops tires)。
<color=black>※</color>Grants 50% damage reduction to スパイクナッツ and 黒曜石のスパイクナッツ on him。
<color=black>※</color>Becomes anti-crush if the plant above is an 黒曜石のスパイクナッツ.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>スパイクウィード→植木鉢</color>

plants.name: ビームシューター
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>ビームシューター started out as a kid who loved shining laser pointers at people. Later, ファロス傘 taught him how to use that trick on zombies instead.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Fires high-frequency targeted lasers; absorbs 光エネルギー to increase power。

<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>10/0.2秒</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>※</color>Gains 光エネルギー equal to 光レベル every 0.5s, up to 1000. Each laser beam consumes(1 + current energy × 10%)energy when attacking or transferring。
<color=black>※</color>Can lock onto a スプリットビーム in front in the same lane(not directly adjacent). Transfers energy every 0.1s, restoring energy equal to 10% of its attack. Each point of energy spent doubles the amount transferred。
<color=black>※</color>Consumes energy every 0.2s to attack, increasing damage by the amount of energy spent。
<color=black>※</color>Click on it will reset its target.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>ピーシューター＋プランタン</color>

plants.name: スクワッシュドローン
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>By harnessing gravitational potential energy, floating スクワッシュes can unleash devastating slams with ease: making the exaggerated wind-up before attacking seem unnecessary. "Not unnecessary at all," explains スクワッシュドローン. "I'm shooing away the ladybugs resting on my leaves, so I don't hit them by accident."</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Repeatedly slams down on zombies beneath him。

<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>100/2s（スクワッシュ）</color>
<color=black>検出範囲：</color><color=#8B0000>Current tile</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>飛行植物。When a zombie is in range, smashes the zombie below repeatedly.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>スクワッシュ＋ブロウヴァー</color>

plants.name: 氷キャベツパルト
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"You have no idea how terrifying that place was," 氷キャベツパルト says, still shaken. "A land of extreme cold, where countless plants were frozen forever. If I hadn't risked my life to open the door back outside, we vegetables would've all died in there." Oh, he's talking about his adventure inside Dave's refrigerator again.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Lobs frozen cabbages and attacks faster when hitting frozen enemies。

<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>40/3秒</color>
<color=#0077b6>Cryo System: </color><color=#8B0000>Attacks inflict 冷却, add 10 氷ポイントs and deal ×4 damage to frozen zombies.</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>On hitting a Frozen zombie, the 弾丸 can bounce once, and 氷キャベツパルト's attack speed is greatly increased for 3s. This effect can only trigger again 1.5秒after it ends.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>氷キノコ＋キャベツパルト</color>

plants.name: 氷カーネルパルト
plants.introduce: <color=#3D1400>To freeze the perfect butter, 氷カーネルパルト made a special trip to Siberia. Now, its butter is as smooth as marble; heavy, hard, beautiful, and makes a satisfying thud when smashed on a zombie's head.'</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Lobs frozen kernels and butter。

<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>20/3秒</color>
<color=#0077b6>Cryo System: </color><color=#8B0000>Attacks inflict 冷却, add 10 氷ポイントs and deal ×4 damage to frozen zombies.</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>Has a 25% chance to throw a frozen butter stick that freezes zombies for 4 seconds.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>氷キノコ＋カーネルパルト</color>

plants.name: しびれケルプ
plants.introduce: <color=#3D1400>しびれケルプ is extremely vigilant. It lives alone, foraging only in shallow waters. When necessary, it even hides beneath zombies to evade predators. It sleeps with one eye open—no easy feat for a plant with only one eye.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>When coming in contact with a zombie, しびれケルプ explodes and attaches itself to other zombies to multiply。

<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>20 × 30</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>When a zombie comes into contact with しびれケルプ, it will burst into 30 kelp 弾丸s that inflict 1 絡み値 before disappearing. If a zombie is killed by the kelp 弾丸, an extra しびれケルプ will spawn on that tile(if possible).</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>パフキノコ→もつれたケルプ</color>

plants.name: レタスパルト
plants.introduce: <color=#3D1400>"Smart robots are so handy! I customized one to my exact specifications, and it's massively boosted my throwing efficiency!" レタスパルト exclaimed excitedly. "Oh, the battle is about to begin." With that, he leaped into a larger version of himself. Moments later, he heard the opponent say, "Smart robots are so handy! I customized one to…"</color>
plants.info:
レタスパルト can launch tinier versions of itself, unmasking its layers to attack more zombies。

<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>60/3s（スクワッシュ）</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>Lobs a mini レタスパルト that deals AOE crushing damage upon landing, then lobs 2 smaller レタスパルトs that deal 50% of the original damage before disappearing. The smaller レタスパルトs lob 2 even smaller レタスパルトs that deal 25% of the original damage and disappear immediately before disappearing itself.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>スクワッシュ＋キャベツパルト</color>

plants.name: 三灯プランタン
plants.introduce: <color=#3D1400>三灯プランタン's favorite number is three. Triple the light, triple the vision, even triple the salary. With savings that generous, he can afford triple the snacks, neatly stored in his triple lamp cases. The triple things that he hates are triple the zombies, triple the waves and triple the gacha levels.</color>
plants.info:
Provides triple the 光 of a normal プランタン and splits lasers into three。

<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>※</color>Provides 3 光レベルs in a 3×3 area。
<color=black>※</color>光サボテン and 光線キノコ anti-ground lasers that pass through will create two additional lasers in the same lane, each dealing 30 damage.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>スリーピーター＋プランタン</color>

plants.name: ヒプノの鉢
plants.introduce: <color=#3D1400>ヒプノの鉢 is well-liked by everyone. Plants, zombies, even mischievous little beetles are all her friends. She works at a mushroom nursery, and in her free time she's a proud member of the Zombuddies Club, often sharing her handmade rainbow clay during holidays.</color>
plants.info:
The charm within the pot nurtures 催眠されたゾンビs。

<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>Grants 催眠されたゾンビs on its tile 33% Damage Reduction and heals 1 HP every 0.04s. When bitten, hypnotizes the attacker and reverts back to a 植木鉢.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>ヒプノキノコ→植木鉢</color>

plants.name: リビーマー
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>The weekly Pool Light Festival is an important social event for リビーマー. Before heading out, it carefully adjusts its lamp hat, the leaves under the brim not only make it look stylish, but also give its firefly friends a place to rest after the party.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Fires two high-frequency lasers。

<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>10×2/0.2秒</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>※</color>Gains 光エネルギー equal to 光レベル every 0.5s, up to 1000. Each laser beam consumes(1 + current energy × 10%)energy when attacking or transferring。
<color=black>※</color>Can lock onto a スプリットビーム in front in the same lane(not directly adjacent). Transfers energy every 0.1s, restoring energy equal to 20% of its attack. Each point of energy spent doubles the amount transferred。
<color=black>※</color>Consumes energy every 0.2s to attack 2 zombies at once, increasing damage by the amount of energy spent。
<color=black>※</color>Click on it will reset its target.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>ピーシューター＋ビームシューター</color>

plants.name: スプリットビーム
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"It's my turn to wear the hat." "But the strap is under my chin."The two heads of the Lumen Relay Shooter argue constantly. Even the Pool Light Festival can't distract them - the only thing that stops the argument is when they start fighting over the eyebrows instead.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Receives laser energy from the left and fires high-frequency lasers。

<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>10/0.2秒</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>※</color>The right head functions like a ビームシューター。
<color=black>※</color>The left head can receive 光エネルギー from ビームシューター-family plants in the same lane(not in directly adjacent tile)。
<color=black>※</color>Click on it will reset its target.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>ピーシューター＋リビーマー</color>

plants.name: ガトリングビーム
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>ガトリングビーム shines brilliantly on the battlefield, often earning four times the credit. Though its glow makes it an easy target, it never backs down. Wounds within the light are a warrior's badge of honor.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Fires four high-frequency lasers。

<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>10×4/0.2秒</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>※</color>Gains 光エネルギー equal to 光レベル every 0.5s, up to 1000. Each laser beam consumes(1 + current energy × 10%)energy when attacking or transferring。
<color=black>※</color>Can lock onto a スプリットビーム in front in the same lane(not directly adjacent). Transfers energy every 0.1s, restoring energy equal to 40% of its attack. Each point of energy spent doubles the amount transferred。
<color=black>※</color>Consumes energy every 0.2s to attack 4 zombies at once, increasing damage by the amount of energy spent。
<color=black>※</color>Click on it will reset its target.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>ピーシューター＋スプリットビーム</color>

plants.name: ししトウガラシ
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Each little ししトウガラシ may be small and insignificant on its own, but together they pack serious heat. That's why they like to stick in groups. Other plants even rate them by size: mild, medium, and extra hot.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Small body, fiery temper。

<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>600（焼夷）</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>低身植物。Explodes when zombies get close, triggering a ハラペーニョ効果 with less damage.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>ハラペーニョ→パフキノコ</color>

plants.name: 毒ピーシューター
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Despite the name, 毒ピーシューター is a chef with a strong signature style. He insists every customer try its specialty, fried peas with garlic powder. The smell alone brings zombies flooding with memories: childhood, family, home… and plenty of tears.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Fires garlic peas that cause poisoned zombies to release toxins, forming a toxic cloud。

<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>30/1.5秒</color>
<color=#5E1675>毒システム：</color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>※</color>弾丸s add 1 毒値 to zombies on hit。
<color=black>※</color>If the zombie hit is already in a Poisoned state, creates a Toxic Cloud at the zombie's feet that lasts for 6s, applying 1 毒値 and dealing damage equal to 20× the total 弾丸s fired in one volley by all Poison-system straight-shooting plants in this lane per second to all zombies caught within. There can be up to 1 active Toxic Cloud per lane.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>ピーシューター＋ニンニク</color>

plants.name: 毒リピーター
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Fight! Fight! Attack! Attack!" 毒リピーター lives with passion and poison. Nothing distracts it, not zombies, not vampires, not even pushy salesmen.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Fires two garlic peas at once。

<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>30×2/1.5秒</color>
<color=#5E1675>毒システム：</color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>※</color>弾丸s add 1 毒値 to zombies on hit。
<color=black>※</color>If the zombie hit is already in a Poisoned state, creates a Toxic Cloud at the zombie's feet.</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>Tap to auto-fuse with a free ピーシューター 15秒after planting.
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>ピーシューター＋毒ピーシューター</color>

plants.name: 毒スプリットピー
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Bouncing shots are a must-have skill for modern Split Peas, but 毒スプリットピー did not bother to learn it. Nor does he had to. He can simply fire garlic peas into the house behind it, and sooner or later someone will throw them right back.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Fires garlic peas both forwards and backwards。

<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>30×3/1.5秒</color>
<color=#5E1675>毒システム：</color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>※</color>弾丸s add 1 毒値 to zombies on hit。
<color=black>※</color>If the zombie hit is already in a Poisoned state, creates a Toxic Cloud at the zombie's feet.</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>Tap to auto-fuse with a free ピーシューター 15秒after planting.
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>ピーシューター＋毒リピーター</color>

plants.name: 毒ガトリングピー
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>At the neighborhood potluck, renowned linguist 毒ガトリングピー proudly served a "traditional recipe" of 'pois' and 'poisson'. It tasted excellent, except everybody got food poisoning afterwards. To this day he still insists the 'poison' was part of the 'Gift'.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Fires four garlic peas at once。

<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>30×4/1.5秒</color>
<color=#5E1675>毒システム：</color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>※</color>弾丸s add 1 毒値 to zombies on hit。
<color=black>※</color>If the zombie hit is already in a Poisoned state, creates a Toxic Cloud at the zombie's feet.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>ピーシューター＋毒スプリットピー</color>

plants.name: トーチランプキノコ
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>トーチランプキノコ made a name for himself by quickly cooking peas into rich pea paste and turning them into "pea tarts." His skills are famous, but so is his terrible business sense. His business goes bankrupt at the rate of one restaurant per year, mostly because he burns through far too many peas just to maintain his hairstyle.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Burns incoming peas, compressing them into a burst of flame。

<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>※</color>Does not attack on its own。
<color=black>※</color>Absorbs passing peas. Every 1s, exhales a piercing flame 4 タイル forward. Damage equals the total damage of absorbed peas, up to 300。
<color=black>※</color>Melts 雪ピー豆 into normal peas.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>フュームキノコ＋炎木</color>

plants.name: ジョーブレイカー
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"So hungry, so hungry, so hungry! I'm starving!" ジョーブレイカー shouts as he lunges at zombies ahead. No matter how much he eats, it's never enough. Oh look - a ガーガンチュア! Finally, a proper meal… Wait, that might've been too much.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Gluttonous スクワッシュ that keeps スクワッシュing when fed。

<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>1800（スクワッシュ）</color>
<color=black>検出範囲：</color><color=#8B0000>1 tile to the right</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>※</color>On landing, attempts to devour one zombie caught underneath. Still deals damage to zombies that are not eaten。
<color=black>※</color>On a successful devour, returns to the field on the same tile, otherwise he disappears.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>チョンパー＋スクワッシュ</color>

plants.name: 悪臭木
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>The fresh aroma of garlic is soothing, while the blaze of fire elevates it to another level entirely. 悪臭木 takes a deep breath, lost in this intoxicating scent, and feels regret that other plants cannot appreciate such beauty.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Cauterizes passing peas, greatly enhancing their toxicity。

<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>Affects specific 弾丸s that pass through:
<color=black> ◎</color>ピー豆：+10 Damage, becomes 毒ピー豆;
<color=black> ◎</color>毒ピー豆：ダメージが2倍, becomes 有毒ピー豆 that also deal スプラッシュダメージ.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>炎木＋ニンニク</color>

plants.name: スプラッシュ
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>スプラッシュ works as a lifeguard at a seaside resort. Everyone is amazed that such a heavy body can still glide effortlessly across the water. When asked about it, he always replies, "That's not something easy to do." In truth, he floats thanks to a buoyant balloon hat, whose manufacturer Hopcap went bankrupt ten years ago.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>水性スクワッシュ

<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>1800（スクワッシュ）</color>
<color=black>検出範囲：</color><color=#8B0000>0.5 タイル to the left; 1 tile to the right</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>スクワッシュ→海キノコ</color>

plants.name: サワロキノコ
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"The fog is too thick! I can't breathe!" サワロキノコ exclaims, stretching his body to raise his breathing pores above the fog. "That's better… though I can't go any higher, or the air will soon be out of oxygen!"</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Fires heavy fume to strike low-飛行部隊. Can extend to focus on aerial targets。

<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>40/1.5秒(Piercing)</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>Click to switch between different attack modes:
<color=black> ◎</color>Low Altitude: hits both ground and air;
<color=black> ◎</color>High Altitude: ×4 damage, anti-air only.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>フュームキノコ＋サボテン</color>

plants.name: 催眠木
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>As a rising star of the poolside variety scene, 催眠木 quickly gained a huge following of zombies and plants alike. Her fiery charm and helpful nature became her trademark. But like many public figures, she is plagued by rumors: plastic surgery and excessive use of cosmetics have always followed her.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Summons ガトリングピーゾンビs from its flames。

<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>※</color>Summons a hypnotized ガトリングピーゾンビ for every 60 弾丸s ignited。
<color=black>※</color>Hypno Peas count as 4 弾丸s。
<color=black>※</color>When bitten, hypnotizes the attacker, and reverts to 炎木。
<color=black>※</color>Affects the following 弾丸s:
<color=black> ◎</color>Peas: Ignited for +20 damage;
<color=black> ◎</color>Hypno Peas: Ignited for +30 damage;
<color=black> ◎</color>Snow Peas: Reverts to Peas.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>ヒプノキノコ＋炎木</color>

plants.name: グラップルケルプ
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>グラップルケルプ has a unique sense of art, believing that absolute chaos is the highest form of beauty. His untamed curls have never been groomed, instead growing into a style of their own. Because of this, he has been absent from every underwater zombie cleanup mission.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Extends tendrils to repeatedly strike enemies in front。

<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>30×3/3s(Piercing)</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>Attacks all zombies within 4.5 タイル in front three times. Each hit applies 1 Tangle Stack and triggers these effects:
<color=black> ◎</color>1st hit: +1 extra stack;
<color=black> ◎</color>2nd hit: Deals additional damage equal to 5×(current stacks on the zombie);
<color=black> ◎</color>3rd hit: 撃退.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>フュームキノコ→もつれたケルプ</color>

plants.name: パフキノコの拡散：フュームキノコ
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black></color>
plants.info:
<size=36>A mushroom cluster formed from パフキノコs dispersed by a フュームキノコ。

<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>Plants down a フュームキノコ in place of the パフキノコ and spawns パフキノコs in equal intervals ahead(decreasing per tile). The more パフキノコs consumed in fusion, the more will be spawned.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>フュームキノコ→パフキノコ</color>

plants.name: パフキノコの拡散：ビクビクキノコ
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black></color>
plants.info:
<size=36>A mushroom cluster formed from パフキノコs dispersed by a ビクビクキノコ。

<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>Plants down a ビクビクキノコ in place of the パフキノコ and spawns パフキノコs evenly across front, upper, and lower adjacent タイル(prioritizing front). The more パフキノコs consumed in fusion, the more will be spawned.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>ビクビクキノコ→パフキノコ</color>

plants.name: キムチパルト
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Thanks to his mastery of chili sauce, his Korean restaurant is always booming. Its owner, キムチパルト, is just as fiery, bold, passionate, and intense. There's only one thing to remember when eating his food: once you're full, leave quickly… or he'll serve you another round.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Hurls 辛いキャベツ that explode into smaller cabbages on impact。

<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>60/3秒</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>On hit, 弾丸 splits into smaller 弾丸s across a 3×3 area(1/3 damage each), all applying 炎上デバフ before dealing damage.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>ハラペーニョ＋キャベツパルト</color>

plants.name: 破壊キャベツパルト
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"I am the hunter of the night," he declares. His dark skin blends perfectly into darkness, but his glowing red eyes often give him away. Still, 破壊キャベツパルト refuses to wear sunglasses, calling it "the gaze of death"… though in truth, he just can't figure out how to take his contact off.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Launches high-damage cabbages that trigger explosions on 焼夷 targets。

<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>1800/15秒</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>When hitting 焼夷 zombies, the 弾丸 causes a small splash explosion dealing 1/3 damage without falloff.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>破壊キノコ＋キャベツパルト</color>

plants.name: 辛いカーネルパルト
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Our ポップコーン is made from 100% natural ingredients!" 辛いカーネルパルト proudly advertises. However, customers often question his claim, mostly because his butter seems permanently burning-hot and impossible to cool.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Throws magma butter that ignite enemies and empower fire-type plants。

<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>30/3秒</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>※</color>弾丸s apply 炎上デバフ before dealing damage。
<color=black>※</color>Has 25% chance to launch Magma Butter(50 damage): applies 4s stun, triggers a full-lane ハラペーニョ効果 with 50 damage, and grants 炎性植物s(ハラペーニョ fusions)+50% attack damage for 6s(Odyssey ones +25% instead).</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>ハラペーニョ＋カーネルパルト</color>

plants.name: 氷ジャガイモ地雷
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"I am the true star of the battlefield," 氷ジャガイモ地雷 thinks. "And a star always makes his entrance at the very last moment." Before the grand review, he even buries himself in cool soil to rest, but not without making sure his perfect hairstyle stays untouched above ground.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Releases condensed icy gas that triggers chain ice explosions from even the smallest contact。

<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>1800</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>On arming and detonation, triggers an ice blast that freezes zombies in a 3×3 area for 4s, dealing 1/3 damage, and triggers secondary smaller ice blasts in adjacent タイル containing zombies.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>ジャガイモ地雷＋氷キノコ</color>

plants.name: Holographic 黒曜石トールナッツ
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>As a deep-rooted plant, 黒曜石トールナッツ hates being constantly moved around. To avoid this, he spent a fortune to obtain a holographic projection device from Grim Arbiter; allowing him to make his holographic projections to help defend the 芝生 instead. Yet, he still remains puzzled: why does he feel pain whenever these holograms take damage?</color>
plants.info:
A holographic projection of 黒曜石トールナッツ.

<color=black>耐久力：</color><color=#8B0000>20000</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：
 </color><color=#8B0000><color=black>※</color>背高植物、圧殺耐性。
<color=black>※</color>Redirects all damage to the main 黒曜石トールナッツ that is being projected.</color>

plants.name: Prickly Bear
plants.introduce:
<align=left><size=36><color=black>"If one were to go travelling, where would be a good place to go?"
Prickly Bear often pondered this question, although he himself laid lazily in place. He was rather delighted to help dutiful bullets fly off in all directions to seek out unique scenery themselves.
plants.info:
Prickly Bear reflects plant projectiles with a resilient body.

<color=black>スペシャル：
</color><color=#8B0000><color=black>※</color>Alternates the direction of projectiles that come in contact with itself (左←→右).
<color=black>※</color>A maximum of 29 projectiles can be alternated in each 1.5s.</color>

plants.name: 岩盤トールナッツ
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>When 岩盤トールナッツ awoke from his slumber, the world before him was vastly different from the one he remembered. He had no idea how long he had slept, recalling only that he seemed to have been moved around frequently during his nap. Later, while chatting with other plants in the garden, he learned that he had been resold as an ancient artifact during the centuries he had slept through.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>An indestructible トールナッツ; its resilience exists in a realm far beyond normal standards.

<color=#4A2900>利用条件：神秘モード</color>
<color=black>耐久力：</color><color=red>640000</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>※</color>背高植物、圧殺耐性。
<color=black>※</color>Immune to damage and mining progression. Can still be affected by insta-kill mechanics and the curse effect.</color>

plants.name: Magma-shroom
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>The key to making a delicious whole roasted lamb is controlling the heat. It can't be too low, or the inside won't cook all the way through; it can't be too high, or it'll burn easily; and you certainly can't use Magma-shroom as an oven - that would just leave you with the lamb reduces to bones, stuck to the Shroom's head.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Works together with your plants to keep everyone warm, ignite your fighting spirit, and command other Napalm-shrooms to unleash a barrage of fiery destruction.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Conditions: 旅行モード｜Unlockable with Napalm-shroom</color>
<color=black>耐久力：</color><color=#8B0000>3000</color>
<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>300</color>
<color=black>Attack Range: <color=#8B0000>Current and adjacent lanes</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：<color=#8B0000>
<color=black>※</color>Subspecies of Napalm-shroom.
<color=black>※</color>Every second, fire-type plants can provide up to 5 points of heat energy depending on their distance from Magma-shroom. The cap of total heat energy is 300.
<color=black>※</color>Does not target zombies automatically. Attacks when damaged or manually clicked.
<color=black>※</color>Attacks will consume the current heat energy to fire Magma Butter at every zombie within its range, with each projectile consuming 100 heat energy. 1.5s after attacking, all Napalm-shrooms in a 3x3 area will automatically fire at the zombie with the highest HP in range; which is treated as a manual fire for the Napalm-shroom(s).
<color=black>※</color>Magma Butter stuns zombies for 4s, inflicts the 炎上デバフ, and triggers a ハラペーニョ explosion. Fire-type plants in the range of the ハラペーニョ explosion gain a 50% attack bonus for 6s.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:</color>
<color=#8B0000>1. Charging speed and max charge ×3
2. Magma Butter Damage ×3</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>変換レシピ：<color=#8B0000>カーネルパルト←→スイカパルト</color>

plants.name: Tundral Glacier-shroom
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>It was a custom during the Ice Age to wear the antlers or horns of captured prey as a display of one's power. Tundral Glacier-shroom was no exception; the countless icicles crowning his head being his trophies - as the "prey" he hunted was the entire Ice Age itself, capturing the world's icy winds and transforming them into an everlasting crown upon his head.</color>
plants.info:
Summons Earth-piercing ice spikes to rapidly freeze the zombie horde and strengthen himself, solidifying like a glacier.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Conditions: </color><color=black>旅行モード</color>
<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>300</color>
<color=black>Attack Range: </color><color=#8B0000>5.2 Tile (Radius)</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：<color=#8B0000>
<color=black>※</color>Every second, raises ice spikes from the ground at the nearest zombie in range, freezing them for 10s and dealing equal splash damage in a 1.5 tile radius that chills and adds 50 氷ポイントs.
<color=black>※</color>Every 60 attacks, gains 1 Arctic power stack and triggers a Doom explosion that deals damage equal to (6 × Attack Power) to all zombies on the field and freezes them for 5s.
<color=black>※</color>Each Arctic power stack provides a 3% damage boost. For the first 200 stacks, each stack additionally grants +1% attack speed and splash radius. Every 10 stacks also increase 氷ポイント inflicted by splash damage by 5.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:</color>
<color=#8B0000>1. Lethal Glacier-shroom Subspecies Unlocked｜+100 Initial Energy
2. Attack Radius ×2</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>Demise-shroom + Ice-shroom</color>

plants.name: 魅惑魔法猫娘（水）
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Many plants ask how does she get her beautiful colours. What many do not know is that she is actually stuck in her 魔法猫娘 transformation.</color>
plants.info:
Fires globally tracking magic projectiles and can use radiant magic to charm enemies.

<color=blue>『Plant Girls vs. Zombies』コラボプラント</color>
<color=#4A2900>利用条件：旅行モード</color>
<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>300×2/1.5s</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：<color=#8B0000>
<color=black>※</color>Global targeting, prioritizes flying enemies.
<color=black>※</color>Manual activation: select a tile in its row to hypnotize all zombies within 1-tile radius; can target flying units. After use, enters 50s cooldown. Each regular shot additionally reduces cooldown by 1s.
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:</color>
<color=#8B0000>1. Ability CD Halved, Ability radius +0.5 tiles
2. 催眠されたゾンビs spawned by her ability deal an additional 30% true damage that ignores damage reduction when biting</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>Hypno-shroom→Cattail Girl</color>

plants.name: 魅惑魔法猫娘（地）
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Many plants ask how does she get her beautiful colours. What many do not know is that she is actually stuck in her 魔法猫娘 transformation.</color>
plants.info:
Fires globally tracking magic projectiles and can use radiant magic to charm enemies.

<color=blue>『Plant Girls vs. Zombies』コラボプラント</color>
<color=#4A2900>利用条件：旅行モード</color>
<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>300×2/1.5s</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：<color=#8B0000>
<color=black>※</color>Subspecies of 魅惑魔法猫娘 (aquatic).
<color=black>※</color>Global targeting, prioritizes flying enemies.
<color=black>※</color>Manual activation: select a tile in its row to hypnotize all zombies within 1-tile radius; can target flying units. After use, enters 50s cooldown. Each regular shot additionally reduces cooldown by 1s.
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:</color>
<color=#8B0000>1. Ability CD Halved, Ability radius +0.5 tiles
2. 催眠されたゾンビs spawned by her ability deal an additional 30% true damage that ignores damage reduction when biting</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>変換レシピ：<color=#8B0000>シャベル←→シャベル</color>

plants.name: Lethal Glacier-shroom
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>No one knows where the Lethal Glacier-shroom came from. He does not like conversation, hates Mammoths, and has a poor relationship with the Fungularity. He simply pours out the cold within his body in silence. From the murky frost, one can smell the radioactive, snow-like ash that filled the air after the world's destruction.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Works in coordination with cryo attacks, frequently triggering cryo explosions.

<color=#4A2900>Usage Conditions: 旅行モード｜Unlockable with Tundral Glacier-shroom's Modifier</color>
<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>300</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：<color=#8B0000>
<color=black>※</color>Subspecies of Tundral Glacier-shroom.
<color=black>※</color>Tundral Glacier-shroom does not trigger on-death effects when turning into Lethal Glacier-shrooms.
<color=black>※</color>Does not target enemies directly. When cryo-type plants hit zombies, it triggers a coordinated cryo explosion in a 1.5-tile radius, applies Chill, then enters a 0.1s cooldown.
<color=black>※</color>After coordinated attacks, gains (total stacks of Arctic power/number of Lethal Glacier-shroom) % attack bonus; this bonus does not stack.</color>
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:</color>
<color=#8B0000>1. Lethal Glacier-shroom Subspecies Unlocked｜Damage ×2
2. Attack Interval halved</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>変換レシピ：<color=#8B0000>Ice-shroom←→破壊キノコ</color>

plants.name: 冬筍地衣
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Snowman-building is one of the most common pastimes in the Snowy Plains, and Snowthorn Winter Shoot Barricade especially enjoys making itself into a snowman. Blending into the snowmen not only conceals itself, but also allows it to severely punish zombies who kick them around. Hearing their screams echo across the wilderness is a lesson etched deep into the bones.</color>
plants.info:
冬筍地衣 releases a ring of snowballs every time it takes a hit!<size=36>

<color=black>耐久力：</color><color=#8B0000>1500</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>※</color>Immune to freeze and glaciation.
<color=black>※</color>Upon contact with zombies, bursts into a ring of snowballs: 5 are black snowballs dealing 100 damage, and 3 are white snowballs.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>冬筍バリケード + Hoarfrost Lichen</color>

plants.name: 氷霜蓮
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>According to legend, lotus flowers in the Snowy Plains grow atop dangerous snowy peaks, visible only to the brave. 氷霜蓮 dismisses this idea. It grows at the ordinary mountain base, using every bit of strength to push through frozen soil and snow. The dark soil stains on its leaves speak of its effort. One does not need to reach the peak; stepping into the Snowy Plains itself is already an act of courage. 氷霜蓮 is the medal of that courage.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>氷霜蓮 uses the cold to grant charges to certain plants, but freezes plants nearby not adapted to the winter.

<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>※</color>Immune to freeze and glaciation.
<color=black>※</color>Gains 1 ice charge every 5s. Gains 1/1/60 ice charges when affected by snowball/snow trident/吹雪 respectively.
<color=black>※</color>May consume 5 charges to awaken. Upon awakening, heals plants in a 3×3 area for 100 HP and applies Freeze, additionally awakening Snow Lotus-type plants and granting 5 ice charge to 水滴アロエ-type plants and Snowbloom Spruce. Afterwards, it enters at least 2s of CD.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>Snow Lotus + Hoarfrost Lichen</color>

plants.name: ピー鉢
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>ピー鉢 is a devoted fan of the ピーシューター. It dyed itself green, made leaf decorations out of paper pulp, and even modified an old vase into a pea cannon barrel. All that’s missing is an autograph.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>ピー鉢 makes certain ピーシューター type plants on top shoot a burst 5 of their projectile once they've fired normally enough.

<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>ピーシューター-type plants on this tile trigger an extra rapid-fired 5 shots every time they fire 30 shots.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>ピーシューター→植木鉢</color>

plants.name: 狙撃鉢
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>From the perspective of the 狙撃鉢, using a sniper rifle is actually not difficult at all. You just need to know how to reload, how to chamber a round, and how to hand the reloaded rifle to a teammate who knows how to use it.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>狙撃鉢 causes Snipea type plants on top to perform a extra attack after every 6th shot!

<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>Snipea-type plants on this tile perform 1 immediate extra attack every 6 attacks.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>狙撃ピー→植木鉢</color>

plants.name: Spruce Snowshooter
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Wanna snowball fight?" Spruce Snowshooter always appears alongside that question. Snowball fights are his favorite and strongest snow sport, where he once achieved a legendary 1 vs 13 victory. "Dare to ambush me? Hah! Take this!"</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>When hit by snowballs, Spruce Snowshooter counterattacks by throwing snowballs forward and backward.

<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>200×3 (black snowballs)</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>※</color>Immune to freeze and glaciation.
<color=black>※</color>Does not target enemies directly. When hit by white snowballs, it scatters 3 black snowballs forward to attack zombies, and 3 white snowballs backward to freeze plants.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>Spruce Sharpshooter + Hoarfrost Lichen</color>

plants.name: Pumpkommando
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"I'm already at full capacity!" Pumpkommando shouts. "Packed with pea bullets!" Even though he always says this, he still tries to squeeze in a bit more space at the end, letting plants hide inside him to block zombie attacks.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Pumpkommando fires regular Peas in bursts of 6, and has a chance to trigger an Ultimate Attack each time!

<color=black>耐久力：</color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>20×6/3s</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>2% chance to shoot a barrage of regular peas each attack, lasting 5s.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>Pea-storm Commando→Pumpkin</color>

plants.name: 破壊スイカパルト
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>You can usually tell a watermelon's taste just by lightly tapping its surface. A crisp sound means a sweet melon, a dull sound means a fleshy one… and a deafening sound? That's a Doom Watermelon.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>破壊スイカパルト throws radiation-infused watermelons that explode on impact, releasing powerful blasts when craters form.

<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>1800/3s</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>※</color>Projectiles do not hit zombies directly; instead they trigger 破壊キノコ explosions on landing (same damage, leaving 焼夷 Craters).
<color=black>※</color>If the landing tile already has a crater or is in water, it deals reduced damage (1/18) in a small area instead; this area's range increases if buffed by Melon Pot.
焼夷 Crater applies 焼夷 debuff to zombies on the same tile.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>破壊キノコ + スイカパルト</color>

plants.name: 氷霜アロエ
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>In snowball throwing, 氷霜アロエ is a genius. With just a single leaf, he can accurately throw snowballs the size of fists, even juggling multiple at once. The only problem is his catching skills: snowballs often end up hitting his own head.</color>
plants.info:
氷霜アロエ continuously throws snowballs, keeping plants refreshed and chilled.<size=36>

<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>40/1.5s (black snowballs)</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>※</color>Immune to freeze and glaciation.
<color=black>※</color>Gains 1/15 ice charge when affected by freeze or Ice-shroom effects.
<color=black>※</color>Continuously throws snowballs at itself if no zombie is in range; if it has a target, there is a 25% chance to switch to throwing black snowballs at zombies.
<color=black>※</color>When throwing white snowballs, can consume 3 ice charges to additionally throw white snowballs to each plant in front as far as 3 tiles ahead.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>水滴アロエ + Hoarfrost Lichen</color>

plants.name: Pumpkin Chest
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Pumpkin Chest is the ideal storage for plant seeds. During Halloween, every household prepares candy for visitors, and this pumpkin has become the perfect container. It has large capacity, solid quality, and a festive appearance, making it very popular. As for whether it secretly steals snacks when no one is watching… who knows.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Pumpkin Chest can store plant 種パケットs for you.

<color=black>耐久力：</color><color=#8B0000>8000</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000><color=black>※</color>Can store plant 種パケットs dropped on the field and retrieve them by clicking.
<color=black>※</color>種パケットs are not retained when the Chest dies or when moving to the next round.
<color=black>※</color>Has 27 slots. Stack limits per plant quality:
	-Base plants: 32
	-Basic fusions: 16
	-Advanced fusions: 8
	-Common Odyssey: 4
	-Epic Odyssey: 2
	-Legendary: 1
<color=black>※</color>In Odyssey gacha mode, has 54 slots and all stack limits are 64.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>Pumpkin→Pumpkin (full HP)</color>

plants.name: 破壊カーネルパルト
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>破壊カーネルパルト is especially skilled at attaching other projectiles behind butter, launching surprise attacks against zombies who underestimate butter-based strikes. He also uses this technique to "borrow" teammates' lunches.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>破壊カーネルパルト uses radiation energy to command adjacent catapult plants to fire in unison.

<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>40/3s</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>※</color>Attacks apply 焼夷 debuff.
<color=black>※</color>Starts with 10 radiation energy. Gains 1 energy whenever a zombie affected by 焼夷 dies in its lane.
<color=black>※</color>25% chance to fire a 60-damage butter. Can also consume 1 energy each to trigger left and right adjacent catapult plants to fire immediately (only one standard shot, fired by itself).</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>破壊キノコ + カーネルパルト</color>

plants.name: スターシューター
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>スターシューター is very proud of itself and believes it shines like a star in the sky. Although others tell it that it does not actually emit light capable of piercing fog or darkness, this does not affect its good mood, and it even helps decorate a city hall ceiling with a starry sky design.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>スターシューター fires star peas that split into multiple stars before impact.

<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>20/1.5s</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>Projectile split into 5 star projectiles in all directions every 0.5s (first at 0.2s), up to 5 times.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>ピーシューター＋スターフルーツ</color>

plants.name: 炎パンプキン
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>炎パンプキン is an excellent restaurant employee. He usually works as a waiter, performs magic tricks during festivals, and when something goes wrong in the kitchen, he can temporarily substitute as a gas stove.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>炎パンプキン stores thermal power; clicking releases it all for a powerful burst down the lane.

<color=black>耐久力：</color><color=#8B0000>4000</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>※</color>When bitten, deals 20 damage to the attacker and applies 炎上.
<color=black>※</color>Gains thermal energy equal to 10% of damage when affected by ハラペーニョ effects. Gains 60 thermal energy when an 炎上 zombie in its lane dies.
<color=black>※</color>Max thermal energy: 1M. Every 30 points of energy increase bite reflection damage by +1. If thermal energy ≥ 1800, clicking or death consumes all energy to release a ハラペーニョ effect with damage equal to stored energy.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>ハラペーニョ→Pumpkin</color>

plants.name: Doom Kelp
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Due to long nights spent researching fusion problems and chronic sleep deprivation, Doom Kelp's eyes are bloodshot. Many colleagues suggested he get more rest and treat his red eyes, but he refused completely. "If I did that… my face would just show as a puddle of pitch black in photos… just the thought of that is terrifying."</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Doom Kelp explodes like a 破壊キノコ on activation.

<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>Insta-kill (Drown) + 1800 (Cremator)</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>Triggers 破壊キノコ effect upon death.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>破壊キノコ→Tangle Kelp</color>

plants.name: Thornweed
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>She used to be a simple Cactus working at the Mammoth research institute, addressing the elephants.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Thornweed can shoot spikes upwards to attack zombies, even airborne ones!

<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>20/1s</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>Each attack fires 3 spikes upward; both regular attack and projectiles can hit flying zombies.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>スパイクウィード + Cactus</color>

plants.name: Snow-me-not
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"Don't worry, I won't hold my saw near you." Snow-me-not reassured the other plants. Although he does keep a firm grip on his circular saw, snow accumulating on the spinning blade is constantly flung everywhere by its high-speed rotation.</color>
plants.info:
Snow-me-not uses its rapidly spinning blades to fling snowballs; attack speed increases with more shields.<size=36>

<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>5/0.02s</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>※</color>刃草の特性を継承する。
<color=black>※</color>Every 10 attacks, fires an additional snowball. Snowballs spiral outward: those heading towards the left are white snowballs; others are black snowballs that deal 4× damage.
<color=black>※</color>Snowball attack speed increases by (Shield/耐久力)×, up to +100%</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>刃草 + Hoarfrost Lichen</color>

plants.name: Bounceweed
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Bounceweed hates being mistaken for elderly bargain hunters going after leftovers at the market. He's actually someone who wakes early every day to grab the freshest veggies.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Bounceweed collects fallen projectiles and reflects them back at zombies.

<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>40/1s</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>When other catapulted projectiles land in the same lane, once at most every 0.7s, it attacks and bounces a copy of that projectile toward the nearest zombie in-lane; returns it along its path if no target exists.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>スパイクウィード + Cabbage-pult</color>

plants.name: Springweed
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Unlike his lazy cousin, Springweed is very diligent in his work as a mental health therapist. So far, the only prescription he has ever written is: "Go jump on a trampoline for a while."</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Springweed knocks nearby zombies upward and disorients them.

<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>80/1.5s</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>Launches zombies straight upward for a short time when attacking. Effect is reduced to 1/3 against ガーガンチュアs. Cannot launch boss zombies or vehicles.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>スパイクウィード + スイカパルト</color>

plants.name: Solarweed
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Solarweed clings tightly to the ground, a reflection of her love for Mother Earth. The buzzing vibrations underground are the finest rhythm of Earth's jazz, though the stomping of zombies passing over is her most hated noise.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Solarweed generates sun when it pokes a zombie.

<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>20/1s</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>Drops 5 sun on each attack.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>Sunflower + スパイクウィード</color>

plants.name: Cyclover
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"High fan power, do not touch." Cyclover warns anyone who tries to get close. "And also, that's my face, not a fan brand logo."</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Cyclover blows back approaching zombies, especially effective against zombies in the air.

<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>1800</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>Every 3s, if there are ground zombies ahead, slowly pushes back up to 3 nearest zombies. Effect is doubled on flying zombies, tripled on zombies knocked into the air, and reduced to 1/3 against vehicles and ガーガンチュアs.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>Blover + Blover</color>

plants.name: Hot Potato
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Hot Potato only wanted to be an ordinary landmine, until an incendiary shell landed on his fuse. Though he's unhappy about no longer being able to stay hidden, becoming the darling of the mess hall has turned out to be a blessing in disguise.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Hot Potato ignites Small Peas and Potato Peas, creating Roasted Potatoes from them.

<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>1800</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>※</color>低身植物. Affects certain projectiles that pass through it:
	Small Peas, Potato Peas: Ignited, +20 damage
	Rolling ウォールナッツs: Damage ×2 and piercing count reset
<color=black>※</color>For every 100+ projectiles affected, creates a non-fusable Roasted Potato ahead (Potato Peas count as 8 projectiles).
<color=black>※</color>Triggers a ジャガイモ地雷 explosion upon death.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>ジャガイモ地雷 + Torchwood</color>

plants.name: Roasted Potato
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Freshly pulled from an oven, Roasted Potato couldn't help but shout, "Which careless fool tossed me in there without preparing me first?" He's so furious that the first thing to bump into him is going to regret it.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>A fiery reflection of a ジャガイモ地雷, with little difference from the original.

<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>1800</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000> 低身植物. Cannot be fused. Can be transformed into an armed ジャガイモ地雷 using an Ice Pot.</color>

plants.name: Pea-nut Commando
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Pea-nut Commando accepted an advertising deal. He was asked to wear a special ウォールナッツ outfit to promote the zombie brain supplement brand 'Nut-o-mix.' So far, the campaign has received zero complaints.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Pea-nut Commando fires mini rolling ウォールナッツs, with its ultimate firing 6 Giant-nuts.

<color=#4A2900>利用条件：旅行モード</color>
<color=black>耐久力：</color><color=#8B0000>8000</color>
<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>30×6/1.5s</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>※</color>Damage received is capped at 1/4 耐久力 per hit.
<color=black>※</color>2% chance to shoot 6 giant ウォールナッツs dealing 20× damage, and gain a Shield equal to 1/4 of its 耐久力 each attack.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>Pea-storm Commando + ウォールナッツ</color>

plants.name: Snapper Snipea
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>A good scope helps a sniper shoot more accurately. By the same logic, it can help a チョンパー bite farther away. If your neighboring チョンパー chews too loudly, perhaps try fitting him with a silencer.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Snapper Snipea devours any zombie it 'snipes'.

<color=#4A2900>利用条件：旅行モード</color>
<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>500/3s</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>
<color=black>※</color>Targets anywhere ahead across lanes, including airborne zombies.
<color=black>※</color>Performs a チョンパー devour effect before damage calculation. Every 6th attack is a headshot, allowing the devour effect to affect any 非ミニボス zombie and deal 1M damage.
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>Snipea + チョンパー</color>

plants.name: Shooty-shroom
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Shooty-shroom learned a remarkable rapid-fire pea tossing trick from the circus. No one knows just how many peas he can throw at that speed. He'd love to show it off to the zombies, but not when they get too close — that would reveal how the trick works.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Shooty-shroom rapidly increases its attack speed and damage while firing, but loses everything when frightened.

<color=black>ダメージ：</color><color=#8B0000>20/1.5s</color>
<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>Gains 5% attack speed and +1 damage after every attack, up to +150% attack speed and +30 damage. This bonus is reset when frightened.</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>ピーシューター + Scaredy-shroom</color>

plants.name: Levitater
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Levitater is deeply troubled. He has a toothache, but can't find a dentist willing to operate on his tiny little tooth.</color>
plants.info:
<size=36>Levitater allows ジャガイモ地雷s on its tile to rearm themselves after exploding.

<color=black>スペシャル：</color><color=#8B0000>When a ジャガイモ地雷-type plant on the same tile self-destructs upon contact with an enemy, it does not disappear and instead buries itself again to rearm (this ability has a 15s CD).</color>
plants.cost: <size=36>融合レシピ：<color=#8B0000>ジャガイモ地雷 + Blover</color>

plants.name: Placeholder Plant
plants.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black></color>
plants.info: <size=36>Information about this plant will be revealed in a future update.
